title: admin.firestore is not a function after upgrading firebase-admin to v14
symptoms: TypeError: admin.firestore is not a function
TypeError: Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'cert') from admin.credential.cert
admin.apps is undefined in an initializeApp guard
cause: firebase-admin 14.0.0 removed the legacy namespace API, so the default import no longer carries firestore(), auth(), messaging(), credential, or apps. It also dropped Node.js 18 and 20.
fix: Switch to the modular entry points (firebase-admin/app, /firestore, /auth, /messaging) and run on Node.js 22 or later.
